title: Maximum Number of Non-Overlapping Substrings
description: Find the maximum number of non-overlapping substrings such that every character in each substring appears only in that substring.
pseudocode:
1. Find first and last occurrence for each char
2. For each char, expand range [first, last] to include all occurrences of chars within
3. Filter out invalid ranges
4. Sort ranges by end index
5. Select non-overlapping ranges greedily

steps.note: Identifying first and last indices for 'a': [0, 2], 'b': [1, 3]
Expand range for 'a' to include 'b' (index 1), new range [0, 3]
Sort ranges: [0, 3] covers everything, select as first substring
